snippet.title: Ariadne's Tale - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014640?utm_source=presskit

Step into Ariadne's Tale, a first-person puzzle adventure that reinvents the classic myth with wit and dark humour. As Ariadne, you carry a magical thread that guides your path and serves as a tool to fix routes, anchor points and activate mechanisms. Use the thread to orient yourself, manipulate devices and reach the heart of the Labyrinth before the beast finds you.

Each chamber is a test of observation and creativity: combine puzzle solving, object manipulation and lateral thinking to progress. The narrative blends ironic voices with a mythic atmosphere: an architect guides (and nags) you through a magical conch, while the terror and beauty of the Labyrinth slowly unfold. The goal is clear: find and rescue Theseus… before the threads of fate are cut.

 
Features:
- Immersive 3D first-person world: explore winding passages and hidden chambers while avoiding deadly traps.
- Magical thread as core mechanic: tension it, anchor it, and use it as a guide and tool to trigger mechanisms and open paths.
- Clever environmental puzzles: from ancient machinery to precision puzzles and rhythmic sequences.
- The Labyrinth’s beast: use distractions, hide in amphorae and avoid direct confrontations to survive.
- A story with humor and satirical tone: sharp dialogue and mythic characters that give the world personality and charm.

Prepare to weave, think and outsmart fate. Ariadne's Tale is for players who love puzzles with character, atmosphere and a healthy dose of irony.

©2026 JanduSoft
